## What's new

**Maps**
- Magic and rare maps are priced from listings: base, tier, atlas drops, item rarity, pack size and quantity, with their implicits asked for. Their mods wait behind the Hidden switch.
- Unique maps are searched by name, Valdo maps by their reward (and without the Void death), blighted maps by their area.
- A conqueror's or an Elder guardian's map asks for its very boss; on the Base view, for any boss of its family. Map implicits show in their influence's colour and symbol.
- The bulk exchange for maps is now a setting, off by default ("Bulk exchange for maps").

**Uniques**
- An unidentified unique opens a grid of the uniques its base can be, with their pictures: click the one it is. A unique that can no longer be found says "Standard only".
- Mods a unique rolls from a pool (Watcher's Eye, Zana's Ingenuity...) are marked in the unique colour.
- Vestigial items are searched as their plain base with the vestigial filter, their implicit shown in violet.

**Gear and jewels**
- Cluster jewels: searched by base whatever their rarity, the passive count in its best range, enchants said short ("Herald damage", "5 passives"), the jewel socket line left out.
- Stats where less is better ("Damage taken", attribute requirements, costs...) are asked as a maximum.
- Armour pieces offer their base defence percentile, off by default.
- Shields ask for their chance to block.

**Panel**
- Live offers for currencies and stackables: up to 20 listings and the market price row.
- A line cut short shows its full text on hover.
- Number fields take copy, cut and paste; a mod without a number has no number field.
- Item options, listing filters and actions have shapes of their own.
- The saved stash searches open under the quick menu and close from the same button.
- No panel when there is nothing to price. Item pictures keep their shape.

## Install

Download `Zenith-win-Setup.exe` below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin rights), adds a Start menu entry and starts Zenith Trade in the system tray. An installed copy updates itself on its next restart.

Windows SmartScreen may warn that the publisher is unknown, because the installer is not signed: click "More info", then "Run anyway".
